english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an unwanted delay holding up a scheduled event, service, or activity.
Use this when the wait is a delay to a service, journey, event, or schedule rather than simply time spent waiting.

examples.english: The flight had a delay because of heavy rain.
examples.jyutping: baan1 gei1 jan1 wai6 daai6 jyu5 jau5 jin4 ng6
